verdicts.decision_note: The client requires the RR01 internal-page header to render the RR-01 report code consistently in the document template.
The client specifies the report-code mapping that the RR02, RR03, and RR04 internal headers must render; the added keys do not obsolete or conflict with the existing RR01 mapping.
First concrete failure: client review found that the RR02–RR04 internal headers displayed RR01 instead of their variant-specific codes.
First concrete post-fix verification: after reviewing the revised files, the client reports that the internal-header report codes now appear correct.
